question.worked_solution:
First, we factor the expression:

$$
{sin}^{2}⁡x{cos}^{3}⁡x+{sin}^{4}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x={sin}^{2}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot ({cos}^{2}⁡x+{sin}^{2}⁡x)
$$

Then, we use ${cos}^{2}⁡x+{sin}^{2}⁡x=1$ to simplify the expression in the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}{sin}^{2}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot ({sin}^{2}⁡x+{cos}^{2}⁡x) & ={sin}^{2}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot 1 \\  & ={sin}^{2}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$

We conclude that 

$$
{sin}^{2}⁡x{cos}^{3}⁡x+{sin}^{4}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x={sin}^{2}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡x.
$$
